audited_criteria.interpretation: Single known export-template calibration. Repair is compared primarily to ordinary feedback, with off as an auxiliary quality control. All six evaluations and known costs, no success lost to either baseline, lower aggregate and common-success whole-job tokens versus feedback, and an actual successful repair on primary common success are required. Report each seed; quality gains and cheap failures are distinct from the token goal.

cost_scope: All roles, failed work, control, recovery and checkpoint costs stay in the audited whole-job ledger.
time_scope: Work, program, lookup and control durations overlap; server time includes cells and evaluation. Do not add these measures.
byte_scope: Control bytes are interpreter-host traffic, not model input tokens.
